evidence: The track sidles and gently climbs through beech forest to the saddle. It is then mostly downhill to Wharfedale Hut, close to Dobson Stream.
About half an hour after leaving Wharfedale Hut, the track opens out and follows a 4WD track over grazed flats coming out at Lees Valley Road.

access_points.quote: Leave your vehicle outside the locked gate, foot access only from here.

doubts: Title names both tracks; main way taken as the full one-way crossing View Hill car park to Wharfedale Hut to Lees Valley Road with DOC's 1-2 days; the text does not state it as one continuous walk but the Townshend Track starts about half an hour beyond the hut. F1 taken as the View Hill car park (start of the Wharfedale Track). Townshend River is crossed twice (no bridge mentioned), recorded as fords. The Fosters Ridge Track junction (slip between it and the hut) is not clearly on the way and is omitted. Whether walkers return or arrange transport is not stated.
